file_roles.evidence: Diff deletes the whole '#ifdef QT_STRICT_ITERATORS' iterator/const_iterator classes (explicit const_iterator(iterator) ctor) leaving 'typedef T* iterator; typedef const T* const_iterator', removing the type that failed to convert.

rationale: The MSVC error is raised in qvector.h when erase receives an iterator that is not convertible to const_iterator. The incompatible strict iterator classes live in qarraydata.h and are removed there.
